purpose: Versioned source pointers for the original method/discipline guidance; no external checklists, figures or full source texts are bundled.
selection_rule: Choose sources by actual design and action. Scope/metadata access is distinguished from reading a full checklist. Recheck current venue and institutional requirements when needed.

sources.title: CONSORT 2025 statement: updated guideline for reporting randomised trials
sources.access: primary article relevant sections and official guideline site
sources.checked_scope: Scope of randomised-trial reporting; protocol, analysis-plan access, post-start changes, participant/outcome denominators and relevant extensions.
sources.limits: Reporting recommendations, not a design-quality score, local ethics approval or proof of treatment benefit.

sources.title: STROBE Statement: combined checklist for cohort, case-control and cross-sectional studies
sources.checked_scope: Design, participant selection, confounders, bias, missing data, estimates/precision and interpretation.
applicability: observational cohort/case-control/cross-sectional reports; descriptive/survey work only when using those designs
sources.limits: Applies to stated observational designs; reporting completion does not identify a causal effect.

sources.title: TRIPOD+AI checklist
sources.access: official two-page checklist and author-maintained site
sources.checked_scope: Development/evaluation data, predictor timing, preprocessing, model evaluation, calibration/discrimination, ethics and model availability.
sources.limits: Clinical prediction reporting; not evidence of clinical usefulness or deployment approval. URL folder year is not the checklist version.

sources.title: PRISMA 2020 checklist
sources.access: official two-page checklist and scope page
sources.checked_scope: Question, eligibility, information sources and dates, search, selection/extraction, risk of bias, synthesis and protocol changes.
sources.limits: Main guideline primarily addresses reviews of intervention effects. Not every narrative or interpretive review has this full scope. No checklist text is reproduced here.

sources.title: PRISMA extension for scoping reviews (PRISMA-ScR)
sources.checked_scope: Purpose and coverage of scoping-review reporting; links to checklist and original paper.
sources.limits: Overview/index checked; not a claim of full item-by-item compliance or quality appraisal.

sources.title: Consolidated criteria for reporting qualitative research (COREQ): a 32-item checklist for interviews and focus groups
sources.access: publisher abstract plus official reporting-guideline scope record; full article not obtained
sources.checked_scope: Interview/focus-group scope and three domains: research team/reflexivity, study design, analysis/reporting.
sources.limits: Does not mandate this checklist for every qualitative tradition; no full checklist is copied or claimed checked.

sources.title: Standards for reporting qualitative research: a synthesis of recommendations
sources.version: O'Brien et al., 2014; official record updated 2023-01-18
sources.access: official reporting-guideline metadata and scope record
sources.checked_scope: Broad qualitative-reporting scope and original-publication identity.
sources.limits: Full source/supplement not obtained; this is a pointer for task-specific checking, not item-level verification.

sources.title: The farming systems approach: Trial methods (direct measurements), sections 9.4–9.5
sources.version: FAO-hosted HTML chapter; publication date not established from fetched page
sources.checked_scope: Trial objectives, controls/randomisation, field replication, CRD/RCBD/split-plot and on-farm context.
sources.limits: Older design guidance, not a current local agricultural permit or universal prescription for replication counts.

sources.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook, 5.4 Product Validation
sources.version: web chapter 5.4 accessed 2026-10-24; print-edition date not verified
sources.checked_scope: Specification verification versus intended-use validation, validation evidence and handling discrepancies.
sources.limits: NASA institutional procedures are not imposed as mandatory for unrelated engineering projects.

sources.title: The ARRIVE guidelines 2.0
sources.access: official overview and scope, not every linked explanation page
sources.checked_scope: Animal-research reporting scope, Essential 10 and Recommended Set, planning relevance.
sources.limits: Does not grant animal-ethics approval or establish compliance with every reporting item.

sources.title: WMA Declaration of Helsinki: Ethical Principles for Medical Research Involving Human Participants
sources.version: 2024 revision adopted by the 75th WMA General Assembly
sources.access: official text relevant sections, including paragraphs 9–10 and 21–23
sources.checked_scope: Participant/data protections, relevant national/institutional context, protocols and prospective ethics review.
sources.limits: Principle source; does not replace applicable local law, institutional decisions, informed-consent scope or project approval.

sources.title: The Belmont Report: Ethical Principles and Guidelines for the Protection of Human Subjects of Research
sources.access: official text relevant principles and applications
sources.checked_scope: Respect for persons, beneficence and justice as US-origin human-research ethics principles.
sources.limits: Not a universal law or a replacement for project-specific jurisdiction and institutional review.

original_guidance: conceptual-normative profile is original argument-audit guidance; no universal normative-research checklist is claimed.
Discipline portraits compose methods and provide context; names alone do not establish methodological or governance validity.
retrieval_limitations: The PMC mirror of the CONSORT article returned a browser challenge; the primary PLOS publication and author site were used instead.
The TRIPOD+AI expanded supplement timed out; the official dated checklist was successfully fetched instead.
The CONSORT editable Word checklist was unsupported by the retrieval tool; the primary article and official scope were used.
COREQ full text and SRQR full text/supplement were not obtained; their limited access is explicit in the records.
